plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for BridgeWave transmission device. It reports uptime, temperature, interface traffic, and voltage, for FlexPort millimeter-wave radios (enterprise PEN 6080).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: BridgeWave radio unit temperature in degrees Celsius (BRWAVE-RADIO brwaveRadioUnitTemperature under PEN 6080). The SNMP scalar reports hundredths of a degree (for example 3650 means 36.50 C), so the query divides the raw value by 100. High values may indicate enclosure heat buildup or radio hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: tx_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: BridgeWave transmitter temperature in degrees Celsius (BRWAVE-RADIO brwaveRadioTxTemperature under PEN 6080). The SNMP scalar reports hundredths of a degree, so the query divides the raw value by 100. This scaling applies only to the two temperature objects, not to RSL or input voltage. High values may indicate RF hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: rsl
metrics.description: BridgeWave receive signal level in dBm (BRWAVE-RADIO brwaveRadioRSL under PEN 6080). The SNMP scalar is an integer dBm reading and is not divided by 100. More negative values indicate a weaker microwave path.

metrics.name: device_in_voltage
metrics.description: Optional BridgeWave radio input voltage (BRWAVE-RADIO brwaveRadioInVoltage under PEN 6080). The SNMP integer is reported as-is because only the temperature objects are confirmed as hundredths-scaled. Missing rows are skipped. This is radio input telemetry and is not promoted into shared power-supply health.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
